**Root cause:** the workbook was frozen 01-27, one day before QINV-002 ($1,800, "January late-posted repair," dated 01-28) hit the ERP. The variance is fully explained by that single late-posted invoice — no other discrepancies in the CESQ AP subledger for January.

Ready for February whenever you are.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

January's gap (QINV-002) closed out cleanly. February opened a new one of the same shape (QINV-003, $3,200, posted after the workbook's 02-26 cutoff) — worth a heads-up to whoever's entering AP invoices, since this is the second consecutive month a period-dated invoice landed in the ERP after the workbook was frozen.
